# Claim card: Constructed detection findings

**Internal drafting control, generated, not public copy.** Generated by `tools/claim-provenance/build.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.

- **Approved factual short form:** On a constructed 24-record corpus, 16 reviewers matched the reference classification at a mean accuracy of 83.9 percent (data lock 15 August 2026).
- **Required limitation:** Constructed corpus and author-generated reference classification; mean of reviewer scores; not reliability and not field performance; the reviewer-level spread.
- **Prohibited shorthand:** "JRS is 83.9 percent accurate"; "83.9 percent reliable"; "detects DRR in real records"
- **Historic result or current capability:** May state a factual historic result. May not market a current detection capability.

- **CL-001 permitted wording:** On a constructed 24-record corpus, 16 reviewers matched the reference classification at a mean accuracy of 83.9 percent (95 percent CI 72.7 to 95.1, participant level; 384 graded reads; data lock 15 August 2026). This is a detection result on constructed records, not reliability and not field performance.
- **CL-002 permitted wording:** On the constructed 24-record corpus, sensitivity was 87.0 percent and specificity 80.7 percent.
- **CL-003 permitted wording:** Across the 16 panel reviewers, individual accuracy ranged from 37.5 to 100 percent (SD 21.0), so the panel mean is not any individual reviewer's expected performance.
- **CL-032 permitted wording:** An exploratory crossed model over the 384 graded reads on the constructed corpus places an average reviewer on an average record at 89.2 percent; the record component is weakly identified.
